subject.title: Feature: configurable dateFormat (UK/US/ISO) for envelope and system-event date display

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new `agents.defaults.dateFormat` display setting for agent-visible envelope and system-event timestamps, and what enum/scope should be public?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but this adds a public config key and changes model-visible timestamp formatting, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Approve narrow display enum
options.body: Add a default-ISO enum such as `iso | uk | us | locale` only for agent-visible envelope and system-event display, with tests proving machine-readable fields stay ISO.

options.title: Keep ISO-only core display
options.body: Decline the config addition and keep sortable ISO dates in model-visible context, leaving locale-specific rendering to caller layers.

options.title: Defer to broader date/time design
options.body: Keep this open as part of a wider temporal-formatting decision that also considers memory artifacts and Control UI timezone/display issues.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow display enum
recommendation.body: Add a default-ISO enum such as `iso | uk | us | locale` only for agent-visible envelope and system-event display, with tests proving machine-readable fields stay ISO.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has recent history on the config schema/docs and envelope-adjacent surfaces most affected by a new `agents.defaults` contract.
